name: Shirakawa-go winter light-up parking reservations
intro: Shirakawa-go, a village in Gifu Prefecture, holds its winter light-up on four days in January 2027. Parking for those days is sold in advance, online only, in rounds. Round 1 is sold out, and round 2 goes on sale on December 1, 2026.

facts.bookAhead: About six weeks: round 2 opens December 1, 2026, for light-up days in January 2027

statusNote: The light-up dates and the round 2 sale date and time are from the Shirakawa-go Tourist Association's official parking page. Its event overview and lodging pages could not be read, and bus tour dates are not confirmed.
popularityNote: Not in our keyword data. Estimate: the light-up is famous, but it runs on only four days and this page covers parking only.
difficultyNote: Official parking page: round 1, on sale from September 10, is sold out. The page doesn't say how fast it went, so this is an estimate.
bookingSteps: Check the light-up dates on the Shirakawa-go Tourist Association website: January 11, 17, 24 and 31, 2027.
Parking is sold online only, on the Tourist Association's website, and paid by credit card.
Round 2 goes on sale at 13:00 Japan time on December 1, 2026. Have the page open before then.
Expect the site to be slow at release. The Tourist Association warns that pages may be hard to open.
Choose your light-up day and pay by credit card to confirm your parking space.
visitorTips: Round 1 sold out, so expect round 2 to go fast.
Lodging in the village on light-up days is allocated by lottery, not first come, first served.
A news report says group bus parking in the village will also need advance booking from December 1, 2026. This is not from an official page.
Bus tours and observation deck tours have their own sale dates, which we have not been able to confirm.

soldOut.label: Watch the Tourist Association website for news of any further sales

faq.q: When does Shirakawa-go light-up parking go on sale?
faq.a: Round 2 goes on sale at 13:00 Japan time on December 1, 2026, online only on the Tourist Association's website. It covers the light-up days on January 11, 17, 24 and 31, 2027.

faq.q: Can I stay in Shirakawa-go on a light-up day?
faq.a: Lodging on light-up days is allocated by lottery, not first come, first served. Check the Tourist Association's website for details.
